title: SOP与方案变更审查

points.K3: 规程要写哪些安全内容
points.K4: 动笔前：谁写、给谁看、为什么

points.K15: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本分步骤的规程手册，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank step-by-step procedure booklet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲SOP与方案变更审查。

shots.scene: 规程手册和审批章两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a procedure booklet and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 规程怎么写、怎么用，变了怎么办？

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着上周的记录，准备把实验做大、换个试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds last week's lab notebook, planning a bigger batch with a different reagent.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把实验放大，再换个试剂。

shots.scene: 阿杰挥手：照上次做就行
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves a hand casually, confident.
shots.narration: 他说：照上次的做法就行。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，拿出规程和审批单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and shows a blank procedure sheet and approval form.
shots.narration: 小研说：条件变了，要先评估审批。

shots.scene: 一份带编号步骤的书面规程
shots.prompt_en: A blank written procedure with numbered step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 标准操作规程，是书面的操作步骤。

shots.scene: 几台不同仪器各配一份规程
shots.prompt_en: Several different instruments, each with its own blank procedure sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 写明危险工作怎样安全地做，一事一规程。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔管理控制层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The administrative control layer of an inverted pyramid glows with a clipboard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程属于管理控制，照着做，不凭感觉。

shots.section_title: 目标：谁来做结果都一样
shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰照同一份规程做，结果一致
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student follow the same procedure and get the same result.
shots.narration: 目标：不同的人照着做，结果都一样。
overlay: 目标：谁来做结果都一样

shots.section_title: 目标：谁来做结果都一样
shots.scene: 三个人结果各不相同，问号
shots.prompt_en: Three results that all differ, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 各做各的、结果不同，说明规程要改。

shots.section_title: 目标：谁来做结果都一样
shots.scene: 一份规程对应一个结果的图示
shots.prompt_en: One procedure sheet linked by an arrow to one result icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一份规程，只管一个结果。

shots.section_title: 规程要写哪些安全内容
shots.scene: 特殊设备和危化品柜旁各一份规程
shots.prompt_en: A special instrument and a hazardous chemical cabinet, each with a blank procedure sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 特殊设备和危险化学品，要有操作规程。
overlay: 规程要写哪些安全内容

shots.section_title: 规程要写哪些安全内容
shots.scene: 规程上一排图标：范围、危害、防护、故障、急救、废物、维护
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet with a row of icons: scope, hazard, goggles, a broken gear, a first aid kit, a waste container and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 写明范围、危害、防护和故障处理。

shots.section_title: 规程要写哪些安全内容
shots.scene: 【实拍】仪器旁张贴的操作规程和责任人信息牌（本校现场，空白或打码，无品牌）
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet and a responsible-person card posted on the wall beside an instrument.
shots.narration: 还有急救、处置和维护，挂在仪器旁。

shots.section_title: 动笔前：谁写、给谁看、为什么
shots.scene: 管理人员、一线人员和负责人围桌商量
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the female graduate student and the older man discuss around a table.
shots.narration: 动笔前先问：谁来写？一起商量。
overlay: 动笔前：谁写、给谁看、为什么

shots.section_title: 动笔前：谁写、给谁看、为什么
shots.scene: 使用者在草稿上提意见
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adds comments to a blank draft procedure.
shots.narration: 给使用者看，就请使用者参与。

shots.section_title: 动笔前：谁写、给谁看、为什么
shots.scene: 废物产生、分类、标识、运走的流程图
shots.prompt_en: A flow chart: waste generated, sorted into three bins, labeled, then carried away. No people.
shots.narration: 先把全过程想清楚，再下笔。

shots.scene: 三层图：指南针、清单、一张步骤卡
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons: a compass, a checklist and a single step card. No people.
shots.narration: 政策定方向，计划排事，程序写做法。

shots.scene: 一个计划拆成多份规程卡片
shots.prompt_en: One plan card splits into several procedure cards: collect, sort, transport, decontaminate, label. No people.
shots.narration: 一个计划，拆成多份规程。

shots.scene: 规程分成四块：条件、背景、行动、文件
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet divided into four blank blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 一份规程有四个部分。

shots.scene: 条件块：人、时钟、问号、地点图标
shots.prompt_en: The first block shows a person, a clock, a question mark and a location pin. No people.
shots.narration: 条件：谁用、何时、为何、在哪儿用。

shots.scene: 行动块：一步一勾的检查单
shots.prompt_en: The action block becomes a checklist with boxes being ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 行动：每一步写清，一步一勾。

shots.scene: 文件块：附录里的法规书本图标
shots.prompt_en: The documents block shows law book icons in an appendix. No people.
shots.narration: 文件：附录列出相关法规和指南。

shots.scene: 规程封面：受控标记和修订号的空白方框
shots.prompt_en: A procedure cover with a blank controlled-document stamp box and a revision number box. No people.
shots.narration: 封面写明受控文件和修订号。

shots.scene: 某一步旁边有警告三角标志
shots.prompt_en: One step in the procedure has a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有健康风险的步骤，要写警示。

shots.scene: 各版本规程归档进文件柜
shots.prompt_en: Several versions of the procedure are filed into a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 写好联系人，各版本归档备查。

shots.scene: 五步循环图：分析、设计、编写、实施、评估
shots.prompt_en: A five-step cycle diagram with arrows forming a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 写规程五步：分析、设计、编写、实施、评估。

shots.scene: 循环箭头回到起点
shots.prompt_en: The cycle arrow returns to the start and loops again. No people.
shots.narration: 评估完再回头改，循环往复。

shots.scene: 阿杰看懂规程，点头动手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads the procedure, nods, and starts working confidently.
shots.narration: 好规程看得懂、做得到、查得清。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台试用新规程，旁边四个问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tries a new procedure at the bench, with four question marks beside her.
shots.narration: 新规程先试用：看得懂吗？做得到吗？

shots.scene: 两人结果对比，旁边记录本
shots.prompt_en: Two results compared side by side with a notebook recording problems. No people.
shots.narration: 结果对吗？不同人结果一样吗？记下问题。

shots.scene: 观察表只有“是”和“否”两个框
shots.prompt_en: An observation sheet with only yes and no check boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 验证用观察题，只答是或否。

shots.scene: 规程草稿旁放着国家标准书本和校规本
shots.prompt_en: A draft procedure next to national standard books and a university rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 编规程，要对照国家和学校的要求。

shots.scene: 负责人签字批准，审批记录归档
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs to approve the procedure, and the approval record is filed.
shots.narration: 批准后才生效，批准过程留记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰按规程一步一步打勾操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows the procedure step by step, ticking each box.
shots.narration: 严格按书面规程，一步一步做。

shots.scene: 跳步的箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An arrow skipping over a step is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不跳步，不凭感觉改步骤。

shots.section_title: 规程不合适，反馈不私改
shots.scene: 有人在规程上涂改，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pen scribbling changes on a procedure sheet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 觉得某步不合适，不能自己涂改。
overlay: 规程不合适，反馈不私改

shots.section_title: 规程不合适，反馈不私改
shots.scene: 阿杰把问题反馈给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports a problem with the procedure to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 把问题反馈上去，批准新版再照做。

shots.scene: 规程上一个循环的日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet with a recurring calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程是活的，要定期审查。

shots.scene: 险情、事故、新设备、新规定四个图标指向规程
shots.prompt_en: Four icons, a near-miss, an accident, a new instrument and a new rule book, point to the procedure. No people.
shots.narration: 出了险情事故、有新危害新规定，就要改。

shots.scene: 旧版规程被撤下，墙上只留新版
shots.prompt_en: An old version of the procedure is taken down, leaving only the new version on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 旧版撤下，现场只留最新版。

shots.scene: 王老师给大家讲解新版规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains the new procedure version to the team.
shots.narration: 规程更新，要通知到每位使用者。

shots.scene: 每人在培训记录上签字
shots.prompt_en: Each team member signs a blank training record.
shots.narration: 先培训，签字确认，再执行。

shots.section_title: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批
shots.scene: 阿杰写好新实验的步骤和评估表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes new experiment steps and a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 做新实验，先写书面风险评估。
overlay: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批

shots.section_title: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批
shots.scene: 电、热、急救三个问号
shots.prompt_en: Three question marks over an electricity icon, a heat icon and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 哪里有电？哪里会烫？出事怎么办？

shots.section_title: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批
shots.scene: 导师审核签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews and signs the form.
shots.narration: 导师和负责人审核批准，再动手。

shots.section_title: 新实验和高危实验先评估审批
shots.scene: 审批单从实验室传到学院、再到学校
shots.prompt_en: An approval form passes from a lab icon to a school office icon to a university office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按本校规定逐级报备。

shots.scene: 一个人偷偷做实验的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of someone secretly doing an unapproved experiment, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 未经批准的实验，绝对不允许。

shots.scene: 出事时周围的人不知所措
shots.prompt_en: People in a lab look confused at an unknown setup, not knowing what to do. No faces.
shots.narration: 出了事，没人知道怎么处理。

shots.scene: 论文选题本和实验台之间一道审批门
shots.prompt_en: A thesis topic notebook and a lab bench separated by an approval gate. No people.
shots.narration: 能写的题目，不等于能自己做。

shots.scene: 老周把一张新任务卡交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a new task card to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 老周交给小研一项从没做过的新操作。

shots.scene: 小研翻现有评估表，新步骤那栏空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips through the existing assessment form; the row for the new step is empty.
shots.narration: 现有评估和规程，没写到新步骤。

shots.scene: 阿杰说先做再说，被打叉；溅洒、气溶胶、锐器问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student says let's just do it, crossed out; question marks over splash, aerosol and sharps icons.
shots.narration: 会不会有新风险？不能先做了再说。

shots.scene: 小研停下，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops and reports her concern to the older man.
shots.narration: 一，先停下，报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 二人一起评估、修订规程，老周签字
shots.prompt_en: They assess the new step together, revise the procedure, and the older man signs it.
shots.narration: 二评估，三修订规程，审核签字。

shots.scene: 王老师培训，老周在旁指导小研第一次操作
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains her, and the older man supervises her first attempt.
shots.narration: 四，培训到位，首次在指导下做。

shots.scene: 做完复查，日历上标出定期复审
shots.prompt_en: After the work, a review checklist and a calendar mark for periodic review. No people.
shots.narration: 五，做完复查，定期复审。

shots.scene: 规模、试剂、设备、人员、场所五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a scale-up arrow, a reagent bottle, an instrument, a person and a room. No people.
shots.narration: 规模、试剂、设备、人员、场所变了。

shots.scene: 温度计和气瓶图标也在变
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer and a gas cylinder icon also change. No people.
shots.narration: 换温度、换气体，都算变化。

shots.scene: 评估表重新填写，负责人确认
shots.prompt_en: The assessment form is filled in again and the older man confirms it.
shots.narration: 变了就重新评估，负责人同意再做。

shots.scene: 更新后的评估讲给每个人
shots.prompt_en: The updated assessment is explained to every team member.
shots.narration: 更新后重新审核，讲给每个人听。

shots.scene: 换了一种手套，样品旁出现问号
shots.prompt_en: A different type of glove next to a sample with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 换了手套，可能影响实验结果。

shots.scene: 换了设备，评估表和记录本
shots.prompt_en: A new instrument next to a blank assessment form and a notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 再小的安全改动，也要评估和记录。

shots.scene: 小烧瓶变大反应釜，热量、压力、气溶胶图标变大
shots.prompt_en: A small flask grows into a large reactor, while heat, pressure and aerosol icons grow bigger. No people.
shots.narration: 放大不是乘倍数，热量压力都变了。

shots.scene: 只看毒性、漏掉爆炸的评估表，爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: An assessment form that checks only toxicity, with an explosion icon breaking through. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：放大上百倍，漏评爆炸。

shots.scene: 放大前重新评估、审批
shots.prompt_en: A scale-up plan with a new assessment form and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 放大前，重新评估、经过审批。

shots.scene: 老李想在实验室加隔断，旁边审批单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plans to add a partition in the lab, next to a blank approval form.
shots.narration: 改布局、加隔断，先评估审批。

shots.scene: 改完后检测仪器检测，合格打勾
shots.prompt_en: After the change, a testing device checks the room and shows a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 改完重新检测，合格再用。

shots.scene: 规程循环：写、批、训、做、改
shots.prompt_en: A loop of icons: write, approve, train, follow, revise. No people.
shots.narration: 规程写清楚、批准、培训、照做、常更新。

shots.scene: 新实验、高危实验旁的审批章
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp next to a new experiment icon and a high-risk experiment icon. No people.
shots.narration: 新实验、高危实验，先评估审批。

shots.scene: 变化图标指向重新评估
shots.prompt_en: A change icon points to a fresh assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 条件一变，重新评估再动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣穿好实验服、束起头发，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a lab coat, with closed-toe shoes, waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲着装要求与个人卫生。
